steps.text: Trimounts, Columbia

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: I don't think there's anything else that needs changing.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Good work, Genne.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Just doing my job.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: All I did was provide the basic data model and do some testing.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: You did all the framework and the content within.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: The Astrological Research Association forum is in one week.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: That hole in the skies over Trimounts must be tough to deal with.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: I doubt it has much impact on our family. Our parents have never been the type to build castles in the sky.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Hm... Mother and Father have been in Trimounts for a while. I haven't had the chance to go see them with all the writing that I have to do.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Do you want to see them, Genne?

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Nope. You're the only Urbica who doesn't make my head hurt.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: What are you plans for this... research brief, I guess?

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: I'll release it for academic usage, free of charge, once I've presented it.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: The stars beyond the Trimounts hole seem to move according to a different set of rules, but that's just a tiny piece of sky. It doesn't encompass all stars.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: With our model, however, all researchers will have access to the rough coordinates of constellations under the two systems, and derive their patterns and relationships.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: It'll make things more convenient for people studying the stars.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Sounds like something you would do alright.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Didn't you say that the stars in the hole have opened up new possibilities for astrology? You've finished what you came to Trimounts to do. How about you look into my fortune for today?

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: You're interested in this stuff again?

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: It's fun, isn't it? Come on, sis.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Alright...

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: (Contemplates)

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: (Mutters)

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: (Raises astrolabe)

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Well?

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: The results seem different from before...

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: 'Today is a day of misfortune for the Liberi.'

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: That's the message from the stars.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: It used to be more specific. Weird...

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Sounds unlucky... well, don't think about it too much. It was a casual question.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Not the first time you predicted big trouble for me, only for me to end up just fine. Let's not dwell on it.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Have you finished your breakfast? I'll get coffee.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Yeah. Thanks, Genne.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Here.

steps.name: Deliveryman
steps.text: Astesia Urbica? I'm here to pick up your package.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Here it is.

steps.name: Deliveryman
steps.text: Got it. Just to confirm, this is the address, and the recipient is Mr. Francois Urbica, correct?

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Yes. Can you deliver it today?

steps.name: Deliveryman
steps.text: Should be no problem. Same town, and you've paid the rush rate.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Good, thank you.

steps.name: Deliveryman
steps.text: You're welcome. Pleasure serving you.

steps.name: Deliveryman
steps.text: Have a nice day.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: A guest? That old Victorian woman next door?

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Mrs. Evans? No, just the deliveryman.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: He came to pick up some documents that I'm sending to Father.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Sis?

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Are you out of your mind?!

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: What is it, Genne?

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: How many times have I told you? Send anything to Mr. Urbica, and he'll put his name before yours!

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: You give him too little credit.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Really? Then tell me, have you ever published an article under your name, and your name only?

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: ...I just felt like something this important calls for review by a pair of expert eyes.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Fine, fine, let's say that's true.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: You could have summarized your questions and sent them to him. Why did you have to send the entire draft?

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Trust me, he'll lift the entire thing and present it himself at the ARA forum, at which point it'll cease having anything to do with you or me forever.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: It's all for the glory of the Urbicas. I don't see any problem with the head of the family presenting it...

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Well, I do!

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Why do you think I went to all that effort to run away from home? So I could live free, without him controlling me all the time!

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: And now you just handed months of our work over to him, just because you felt like you wanted his eyes on it?

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: It's my research too. Did you even think about asking me before sending out my results?

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: I didn't think—

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: You didn't think? Someone as careful and thoughtful as you?

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Trust me, Genne, you're worrying too much. It's not as bad as you think. We're an important family, and Father will only sign the family's name on something as important as this.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Plus, he's reviewed and even edited my past papers. He discussed with me the pros and cons of adding his name to the top, and I agreed.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Yes, I know that all too well. Nice flowery words like 'for your own good', promises that will never be kept, and you fall for it, just like that.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Watch your mouth, Elena!

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: You know what? You sound just like he did when he'd scold me, Astesia.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: I only wanted to put the best foot forward with this, Genne. Why don't you put your paranoia aside? Trust me, I'll take care of things.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: You could never say no to him, and you expect me to trust that you can take care of things?

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Enough. There's nothing more for us to talk about.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Where are you going?

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Back to Rhine.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Genne...

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: This is Genesis's communicator...

steps.name: Rhine Reception
steps.text: Do you need something, consultant?

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Where is Rhine's employee housing?

steps.name: Rhine Reception
steps.text: Are you looking for someone in particular? I can reach them by phone here, whether they're home or at work.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: That'd be great. Can you get Elena Urbica of the Energy Section on the line for me, please?

steps.name: Rhine Reception
steps.text: One moment...

steps.name: Rhine Reception
steps.text: You're looking for Elena Urbica, correct?

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Yes. Is something the matter?

steps.name: Rhine Reception
steps.text: Well... Researcher Urbica seems to have moved out of her apartment when she applied for external assignment.

steps.name: Rhine Reception
steps.text: Records indicate she is not currently residing at Rhine.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Did she come to work today?

steps.name: Rhine Reception
steps.text: Hm... could I verify your identity first?

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Sure.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Visiting Bibliography Consultant, Astesia Urbica.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: (Hands over ID)

steps.name: Rhine Reception
steps.text: Everything seems to be in order. One moment while I look this up.

steps.name: Rhine Reception
steps.text: I'm sorry, but Researcher Urbica hasn't tapped into any Rhine Lab facilities today.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: She hasn't been back to Rhine?

steps.name: Rhine Reception
steps.text: Seems that way.
She gets a bad feeling.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: ('Today is a day of misfortune for the Liberi.')

steps.name: Rhine Reception
steps.text: Is there anything else you need?

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: No, thank you.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: (Stop scaring yourself. It'll be fine.)

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: (She's just off the grid for a minute because she doesn't have her communicator on her.)

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: (Maybe she went out for a walk around Trimounts.)

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: (The police station is this way, isn't it?)

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: (I need to find her...)

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Pol...
She swallows the words before they come out.
She started thinking about it.
All the top astrologers are gathered here in Trimounts right now, her father foremost amongst them.
What will happen if the reporters learn that a rebellious daughter of his has gone missing?
They would undoubtedly jump on the story.
Nothing good could come of it, not for her family, her parents, or for her sister.
And so...
She passes by the police station.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: (I'm sorry, Genne... I'm such a useless sister...)

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: (Come on, Astesia, think...)
Watch out! Runaway car!

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: (Who should I go to?)
Aaaaaaaaghhh!!!

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Are you okay? Are you hurt?

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Sorry, I got distracted.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Dur-nar...? What are you doing here?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: I thought you looked familiar. Turns out it was you, Astesia.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Some kind of luck, almost getting hit by a car in the middle of the day.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Same goes for the driver. Probably a broken part somewhere. Only so long you can avoid hitting someone.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Is he alright?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: He finally got the car stopped, but flipped it over in the process.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Looks like he's okay, though. Just climbed out from the car. That's him talking on the phone right now.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Some luck. If Rhodes Island...

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Oh yeah! I can look for Rhodes Island!

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Do you have a minute, Dur-nar?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Er... I guess so.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Can I ask something of you, or rather, of Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Let's go to the Trimounts office. This isn't the best place to be talking.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Here, drink some water.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Thanks...

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Well, if you ask me, it sounds like a little sisterly argument and that's all.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: You don't understand. From what I divined today... she may be in trouble.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: You're the one in trouble. You almost got hit by a car.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: I'm fine.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: You sure can be stubborn... just like my sister.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Older or younger?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Younger sister, at least biologically. I came to Trimounts because she's doing business with the charlat—I mean, astrologers.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: A lot of the reserves are on vacation anyway. I had a bit of time on my hands, so I decided to come here and help out.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: I see...

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Do you get along well?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Well enough, but sometimes she gets a little bossy, or does things for me without asking me first.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: You said she's your younger sister?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: I said biologically. But she acts more like an older sister.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Thanks to her, business actually got better after my father left. Compare that to her vagabond older sister.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Don't say that. We're all grateful to you for teaching us how to survive. I still remember how you sent me flying with one swing of your sword.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: I was new on the job then. When I saw you waving your blade around like a feather duster without actually striking... ah, no sense bringing that up.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: You want the Trimounts office to help you look for Astgenne, right?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: There's a few scouts around who don't have anything to do right now. You can give them a list of places your sister is likely to go to. They'll be happy to help.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: We can do this quiet, if you don't want word getting out. I know them pretty well, and I can help you take care of things.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Thanks...

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Don't mention it. Every family has its own challenges.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: I sent out the private messages. Let's go check the remaining places. Maybe we'll find something.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: A-Alright.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Don't worry, no one's gonna get hurt.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Astgenne sure can hide. We've searched most of the public areas, and didn't even catch a shadow.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: It's getting late. You should go home, and we can pick this back up tomorrow.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: I... I want to keep looking for a little longer.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: It's almost midnight. Your divination only said today was unlucky, didn't it?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Go home, have a hot meal, sleep well, and maybe things will get better tomorrow.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Let's go. I can walk you home if you want.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: No... thank you... sorry about taking up your day.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Don't mention it. I'll be going. Take care, and don't do anything stupid.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Okay...

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: I'll come first thing in the morning. Nighty night.
Astesia walks home alone. The stars are visible in the hole in the sky above Trimounts.
But she only has her eyes on the road ahead, as she navigates bend after bend.
As the clock strikes twelve, she rounds the last bend, and arrives at her rented apartment.
There, she sees a ball of feathers curled up in front of the door.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Sis, you're back...

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: I forgot my key...

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Sis?
Astesia says nothing. She buries her face in her sister's chest, sobbing.
She can't keep her emotions in check, and she doesn't want her sister to see her face.
Astgenne knows that, and so she stands there, holding her sister in her arms, allowing the tears to soak through her clothes.
For a long time they stand there, until both of them have calmed down sufficiently, and Astesia takes out her key and opens the door.
The sisters sit side-by-side on the sofa in silence.
Finally, the older of the two speaks first.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Sorry, Genne... I was wrong...

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: I'm partly to blame too... I just exploded the moment you said you sent Father the paper, and I couldn't listen to anything else.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: I know the sacrifices you made to get away from home. You don't want anything more to do with Father.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: It's like stabbing you in the back. I didn't think it would go like this...

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: It's normal to ask your mentors to review a paper, just like in grad school.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Look at me. I have a PhD, but I couldn't even keep my emotions in check. I call you hard-headed, but I'm the one who doesn't listen...

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: I... I made up my mind. I'll go and see Father tomorrow. It'll take some time for him to get through the draft, and he wouldn't be done so early. I'll convince him to give it back. We still have a chance.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Um... about that.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Actually, the package never made it to Mr. Urbica.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: You remember the deliveryman, the Liberi? He came to apologize just as the sun was going down and refunded the delivery fee.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: He had a pretty bad day himself. HIs truck flipped on its side after picking up his morning packages.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Oh...

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Since your package was urgent, he took a bicycle to deliver it while his coworkers dealt with the rest.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: It was raining when he passed through the business district and he fell into a pond, getting everything soaked.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: He was in tears when he came to apologize. I consoled him and sent him on his way.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: You were right, sis. Today was a bad day for the Liberi...

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: It's all in the past. Don't think any more about it.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Here, your terminal.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Thanks.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Bad habit I picked up studying in Trimounts.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: When I get mentally stuck or get into an argument, I just feel the urge to throw everything to one side.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: I leave my communicator behind, separate myself from phone and email, and just take a walk around Trimounts.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Let time take care of any emotions I can't.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: And from every once in a while, I forget my key, like I did today, and have to wait at the dorm entrance for someone to let me in...

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: You didn't eat all day?

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: No... I had no appetite when I left, and I was locked out when I came back.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: What about the box?

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: I bought some ice cream as a make-up gift, but I didn't expect you to be looking for me all day, so it's melted.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Didn't you have any money on you? Don't starve yourself.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Not after I bought your gift.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: I'm hungry...

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: I'll make something. Wait a while.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Okay...

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: I promise I won't just hand months of our work over to someone else.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Not even our father.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: I believe you.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: My sister.
One week later...

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: I looked through the draft of your presentation. No issues.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Did you memorize all the terms?

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Good. You'll be able to fend off any old timers who try to grind you on terminology.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: But you said you were speaking in the afternoon? I didn't see your name on the schedule.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Remember Mrs. Evans, from next door?

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: The old woman? What does she have to do with this?

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: She's an authority on Victorian astrology. She was supposed to be giving a presentation this afternoon.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: I convinced her to let me sub in for her.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Mm-hm.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Does that mean the space next to Mr. Urbica will be empty?

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: No, Genne.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Er... why are you looking at me like that?

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Don't tell me you want to...

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Give Father a surprise? Let him know that his favorite daughter has gone bad like her sister?

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Please, Genne.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: You had this all planned, didn't you? That's why you didn't say anything about the Astrological Research Association. You were just waiting for me here.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Come.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: ...Do I have to?

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Running away won't achieve anything, Genne. Here's your chance to take Father head-on.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Come, take off your goggles and equipment.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: And change your shirt and jacket.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Are you sure about this...?

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: It's a practical joke. Your favorite thing.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Wait, since when did I become a practical joker?

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Let your hair down. Now that's a good girl.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Sis... are you really sure about this...?

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Just shut your mouth and hold the sword and astrolabe. I'll do your makeup.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Perfect.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Please, sis... there's got to be another way.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Sorry, Genne, the forum is about to start. There's no time.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Try speaking in my tone.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Sia... a-are you really really sure about this...?

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Bah, no, I can't talk like that.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: That was perfect.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Would it really fool Mr. Urbica?

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: You don't need to fool Father. You just need to fool everyone else.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Plus, I'm wearing your clothes. What are you gonna wear?

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: The most formal outfit, of course.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: 'Starseeker.'

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Phew. So glad to be back in light clothes.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: How did it go?

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: A bunch of stuff went over my head, but for the most part, it was pointless bickering over a bunch of papers...

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: I would have left if you weren't speaking.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: What about Father?

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Father, well...

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: He's a good scholar.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: The others place tradition above everything else, but he's willing to admit the changes happening before him, telling the rest that knowledge needs regular development and updating.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: He scolded those old hard-heads like he was scolding us. He's consistent, at least.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: That doesn't mean he's not a giant jerk, just like Ferdinand.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: What about Mother?

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: She was glaring at everyone with her cold, statuesque eyes, as usual.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: They didn't say anything about your outfit?

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: All they did was raise an eyebrow when they saw me. They didn't even so much as say, 'Hello, Astesia.'

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Maybe the game was up the moment they saw me.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Never mind that silly stuff.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Good speech. The two old Urbica hard-heads never brought up any objections, and you dispatched the other nitpickers with ease.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: I hear you're already getting interviewed by the press?

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Yeah, they just asked some pretty standard questions. But I also got questions from two foreign scholars.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: We exchanged contact information, and we may be able to work together to improve the model and promote its usage in academia.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: As for Mother and Father...

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: I'm sure they expressed their dissatisfaction with me in the sternest tone, staring straight ahead.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: They've always been like this. They've never changed.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: (Fake voice) 'Astesia needs to know her place in the family.'

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: They're obviously mad at you.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Haha, don't say that, Genne.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: What are you gonna do now?

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: We'll stay in Trimounts for a while longer. We've been too busy to go sightseeing or shopping.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: There's still time left on this apartment lease.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: I'll go back and report to Father once everything here is taken care of, and once things have cooled down a little.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: I'll tell him that this was the fruit of me and my sister's labor, and that I won't let him put his name on it.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Finally, you've come around.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: What about you, Genne? Are you going back to Rhine? I hear your old mentor is back with a directorship.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: No way. Rumor has it he's even more cantankerous when bossing people around these days.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: But if I'm being honest, Director Clooney's current project is... intriguing.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: How could I not be interested in a form of energy that can send a building into the sky?

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: But that's not a good enough reason for me to go back to working under a man like him. No opportunity is worth that.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: I've made up my mind. I have no regrets.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: I'll follow your example, Genne.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: You're already my example.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Well, there are worse things than your sister complimenting you.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Let's eat out today.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Alright!

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: By the way...

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Yes?

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Give me a heads-up if you're going back home.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: I thought you didn't want to go back.

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: I want Mr. Urbica to know that the two of us are a united front against him.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Now that's exaggerating things a bit...

steps.name: Astgenne
steps.text: Well, I won't go if you don't want me to.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: That's not what I meant.

steps.name: Astesia
steps.text: Let's go together.
